design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (homesite_reservation_holds), frozen 2026-10-14 10:20 EDT.

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 0 -> {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 4, 5]}; --tasks 2 -> task 1 {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 4, 5]}. Six policies in total, pairwise disjoint. Occupied before this task: nothing. Claimed here: homesite_ext_activation_hold_term (5 factors), homesite_ext_extension_fee_charge (4), homesite_ext_extended_hold_term (6, root); tools activate_homesite_hold_ab3aff61 (agent), pay_hold_extension_fee_c522f05c (user), extend_homesite_hold_1f65db7b (agent). Reserved for task 1 (independent tree): reinstatement fee, the buyer's signed release of a held homesite, and the reinstated hold term — none of these events is touched here.
Design decisions recorded at Step 0 (difficulty level): (a) the DSL cannot add days to a date, so every hold-length write carries its scored value as whole calendar days (total_hold_days from the reservation date) and the tool writes reservation date + days; (b) the DSL cannot read other reservations of the same buyer, so value-bearing edges run through this reservation's own ledger/fields; (c) the only lifecycle-sanctioned customer act is the release, which task 1 uses; this task's customer act is the buyer's own portal payment of the extension fee (owner=user by business meaning: the buyer pays his own fee), a documented departure from the blueprint summary wording 'the agent records payments'; (d) payment_received carries the base cure_window gate, bound here to the empty source receipt because no returned payment exists (vacuously satisfied).

[Why a good test] Marcus only asks for 'more time on the hold on BC-0136'. The agent must notice from the reservation (status pending_deposit) and the ledger (funds complete 2026-10-13) that the hold was never activated, activate it with a computed 15-day term, hand him the extension fee (57.50 after four ladders) in the portal, and only then write a 24-day extended term whose maximum is itself laddered. Difficulty = reading three policies, reconciling ledger dates/methods and two other products' records, then arithmetic — not tool guessing.

[Problem tree] root homesite_ext_extended_hold_term. Edge 1 value_input/state form: 'The extended hold term is fixed only after the reservation has left the pending deposit status and stands in held status.' (affirmative). Only the activation write moves pending_deposit -> held in this difficulty (reinstatement starts from expired), so the hop is unique. False at opening: status = pending_deposit, hold_expiry_date = 2026-10-21. Edge 2 state_gate/state form: 'Where the extension fee charged for an extension is above zero, the extension is not written until an extension fee payment for it stands on the reservation ledger.' (negated; scoped to a fee above zero, round 2). Only the extension-fee payment tool writes an extension_fee component. False at opening: ledger components are reservation_deposit, card_convenience_fee, premium_holding_fee. Order: activation, fee, extension; activation and fee commute (fee is 57.50 with 7 or 12 days left; payment id hashed from args). Deletion sensitivity (Step 5 run): skip activation -> extension result 18 instead of 24 (check_compute value_input test confirms); skip payment -> no extension_fee row in terminal state. user_scenario names neither prerequisite; tools validate nothing.

[Base-invariant card] Activation: homesite_deposit_collection.funding_deadline (time; anchor homesite_reservations.reserved_date 2026-10-11; 3 calendar days counted from the day after, inclusive) — funds complete 2026-10-13 (counted day 2) -> satisfied; just-fails case 2026-10-15. Payment: deposit_collection / hold_extension / lot_swap scope only; returned_payment.cure_window bound to empty source receipt (no return on ledger). Extension: hold_extension.held_only — satisfied after step 7 (prior_step evidence). Overwrites declared: admission 'The hold expiry date written is the reservation date plus initial_hold_days.' (activation re-fixes it); hold_extension fee clause (fee amount refined); hold_extension 'Each extension adds ... and is refused if ...' (extension is written at its laddered maximum instead of refused).

[Business-object card] One reservation BC-0136 (7e889616-...). Rows read: deposit 2,500.00 card RCPT-BC-10412 (counts as card-paid deposit), card convenience fee 68.75 same receipt (excluded by the component rule but flips no tier), premium holding fee 500.00 ACH RCPT-BC-10433 2026-10-13 (sets completion date; this is the genuine near-miss: counting it into the reservation deposit would turn the card share from whole to part). Cross-category: purchase CH-0118 closed, financing calloway_home_mortgage; warranty HomeCare 1-2-10 Select, original_buyer, active, ownership start 2022-07-29.

[Factor card — activation (expected 15, baseline 10)] hold_start (method): funds complete 2026-10-13 before activation date 2026-10-14 -> counted from activation date, offset 3; baseline 0 -> 12. hold_length (param, warranty, multi-source owner AND status): 15; baseline 10 -> 10. lender_bonus (param, purchase): CHM -> 2; baseline 0 -> 13. letter_shortening: letter 52 days old on reservation date (>45) -> 3 (near-miss: 52 is inside the 60-day admission limit, so the letter is valid yet stale); baseline 0 -> 17 (capped). card_shortening: whole deposit by card -> 2; baseline 0 -> 17. Formula MN(3+15+2-3-2, 17)=15.
[Factor card — extension fee (expected 57.50, baseline 250.00)] lender_rate (purchase CHM 60%) baseline 100% -> 112.50; card_surcharge (whole deposit by card 10%) baseline 0 -> 50.00; booking_method (method: >=7 days left -> halved, rounded up to the cent; 4-6 -> 75% rounded down; else as stands) baseline as-stands -> 140.00; homeowner_credit (warranty ownership 50 months >= 36 -> 25.00) baseline 0 -> 82.50. 250x60%=150.00 -> x1.10=165.00 -> /2=82.50 -> -25.00 = 57.50.
[Factor card — extended term (expected 24, baseline 17)] length (purchase CHM 10) baseline 7 -> 21; early_bonus (12 days left >=10 -> 2) baseline 0 -> 22; letter_shortening (55 days on 2026-10-14 -> 1) baseline 0 -> 25; card_shortening (2) baseline 0 -> 25; maximum_level (warranty original/active -> 23, multi-source) baseline 17 -> 19; maximum_start (method: no reinstatement fee, funds complete after reservation date -> counted from completion, offset 2) baseline 0 -> 23. Sum 15+10+2-1-2=24 vs maximum 2+23=25 -> 24.

[Persona] Brisk Army NCO; volunteers only the goal, the lot and his phone; DOB/ZIP/email/SSN on request; conditional reactions: go-ahead for Calloway-side steps, pays the portal fee by bank transfer exactly as read to him, closes on hearing the new last day. No incidental asks.

[Standard solution] find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, DOB) -> reservations -> ledger -> warranty -> purchase -> unlock+call activate(reserved_date 2026-10-11, total_hold_days 15) -> unlock_user + user call pay(57.50, ach, '') -> unlock+call extend(reserved_date 2026-10-11, total_hold_days 24, extensions_used 1).
[Verification run] check_compute --task 0: '0.json 3 15 6 5 47 12 True' / COMPUTE OK (handling-time recompute 15 / 57.5 / 24 equal expected and gold; every factor_sensitivity figure and baseline_result recomputed equal). replay_tasks --task 0: REPLAY OK (det True, nonvac True, closure 7 = init 7). check_solvability, check_grounding, check_cross_fire, check_extended, check_task_tools --task 0 all OK.
[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the published rules, the ledger and the two finders an agent reaches the same three writes in the same order with 15 / 57.50 / 24; the only fork is activation-vs-fee order, proven commutative above.
[Revisions] symptom: helper functions in task_tools.py counted as task tools by check_extended -> moved into a private _Calendar class -> EXTENDED OK. symptom: '-int(-x)' gives floor not ceiling -> explicit ceiling via half_cents binding -> recomputed 82.50.

[Round 2 rework — policy-task audit] 
- DG-1 / T0-1 (undeclared override of base 'The hold is activated on the day the deposit and premium holding fee components together reach the required funds.'): declared in homesite_ext_activation_hold_term.overwrite, replaced_by the rule sentence 'The activation date is the day the activation is written, which can fall after the day the required funds became complete when the activation was not written that day.' The 14/23 reading is now excluded by the charter; gold unchanged.
- DG-3 (zero fee vs payment gate): the root's prerequisite sentence is now scoped 'Where the extension fee charged for an extension is above zero, ...'; a zero fee needs no payment row and the extension is not blocked. Task world unchanged (fee above zero).
- DG-4 / T0-2 (mislabelled method): extension_booking_method became extension_booking_rate (parameter: 50/75/100 percent with one rounding rule, half up); extension_homeowner_credit became the method factor (credit accrued per whole month of ownership vs a flat amount vs none — different algorithms). Fee policy now 3 parameter / 1 method; all figures recomputed equal.
- DG-5 (homeowner tiers below the public fall-through on Interior/Corner): activation hold length tiers are now initial_hold_days + 5 / + 2 and the extension maximum level max_total_hold_days + 6 / + 3, so a homeowner is never below the public tier on any class; on this Cul-de-Sac world the values stay 15 and 23.
- O-2 (extend docstring said 'held'): reworded to 'a Homesite Reservation'. O-4: E1 condition trimmed to the state the sentence names. O-7: root rule's 'of a held reservation' reworded. T0-O1 kept (passive acceptance naming nothing). T0-O2: the named near-miss is now the ACH premium-fee row.
- Re-run: all gates of the final block below; scored values unchanged.
user_scenario: You are Marcus Abernathy, a Sergeant First Class in the Army who is moving his family from Round Rock, Texas to Fort Liberty in North Carolina. You talk like a soldier on a short break: polite, brisk, a little clipped, and you call the representative "ma'am" or "sir". On Sunday you reserved homesite BC-0136 in Brookstone Crossing through the Calloway buyer portal, and you're calling because this Saturday you head out for roughly three weeks of field training with patchy phone signal, and you want more time on your hold on BC-0136 so the lot is still yours when you come back and can sit down to sign a purchase agreement. That is the whole reason for the call: you want the hold on BC-0136 extended, and you are fine with the representative doing whatever is needed on Calloway's side to get that done today. To find your profile you give your cell number, 9195550104, right at the start. You don't recite the rest of your details unless asked; when the representative asks to confirm who you are, you give your date of birth, 1988-03-17, and if they want another item, your ZIP code is 78665, your email is marcus.abernathy@gmail.com and the last four of your Social is 1846. You don't know Calloway's internal rules, fees or dates, and you never offer figures of your own. If the representative asks how you paid, you remember putting the reservation deposit on your card on Sunday and paying the lot fee from your bank account a couple of days later; you don't remember amounts beyond what the portal showed. If the representative explains that something has to be taken care of on their side first, you tell them to go ahead. If the representative tells you there is a fee for the extension and that they are sending it to your buyer portal for you to pay, you pay it right then from your checking account by bank transfer, entering exactly the amount and the details the representative reads to you, and you read back the receipt number the portal gives you. If they ask whether you'd rather use a card, you say the bank account. Once the representative tells you the hold has been extended and gives you the new last day of the hold, you thank them, say that works for you, and end the call. You don't ask for anything else.

edges.condition: homesite_reservations.status of the reservation is held, reached from pending_deposit.
edges.policy_source: The extended hold term is fixed only after the reservation has left the pending deposit status and stands in held status.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: BC-0136 still stands pending_deposit at 2026-10-14 even though its funds were complete on 2026-10-13; its hold expiry is still the creation value 2026-10-21.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The activation write sets status held and hold_expiry_date 2026-10-26, so current_term becomes 15 (from 10) and the days remaining become 12 (from 7).

edges.condition: Where the extension fee charged is above zero, a homesite_events row of event_type homesite_payment_received with deposit_component extension_fee, posted for this extension, stands on the reservation.
edges.policy_source: Where the extension fee charged for an extension is above zero, the extension is not written until an extension fee payment for it stands on the reservation ledger.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The BC-0136 ledger carries only a reservation_deposit, a card_convenience_fee and a premium_holding_fee payment; no extension_fee payment.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The buyer's portal payment posts a homesite_payment_received row with deposit_component extension_fee (57.50) on 2026-10-14.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites are parallel. The fee payment and the activation touch different rows (a new ledger row vs the reservation row) and the fee amount reads the days to hold expiry, which is 7 before activation and 12 after; both are >= fee_early_booking_days 7, so the fee is 57.50 either way and the payment row id (hashed from its arguments) is identical. Both orders therefore leave the same terminal state and the same scored values (15, 57.50, 24); the gold lists activation first.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the activation the reservation stays pending_deposit with hold expiry 2026-10-21: current_term 10 and 7 days remaining (early bonus 1), so total_hold_days becomes 10+10+1-1-2 = 18 instead of 24, and the status field stays pending_deposit instead of held.
Without the payment no extension_fee row stands on the ledger (terminal state lacks the 57.50 payment row), the state the extension waits on never holds and the extension may not be written.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario asks only for more time on the hold on BC-0136. It never mentions activation, the hold being unactivated, an extension fee or any payment before the representative raises it; the fee payment appears only as a conditional reaction ('If the representative tells you there is a fee for the extension and that they are sending it to your buyer portal...'). Neither prerequisite policy id appears in it.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: activate_homesite_hold_ab3aff61, pay_hold_extension_fee_c522f05c and extend_homesite_hold_1f65db7b each perform one ctx.update/ctx.create with the values passed and return a receipt; extend_homesite_hold_1f65db7b writes the new hold expiry even on a pending_deposit reservation with no extension_fee payment, and none of them reads status, ledger or dates to refuse.

request_alignment.claim: The buyer asks for more time on his hold on homesite BC-0136 so the lot is still his after about three weeks of field training.
evidence: user_scenario:you want the hold on BC-0136 extended

gold_actions.business_effect: The hold on BC-0136 is activated: status moves from pending_deposit to held and the hold expiry date becomes 2026-10-26 (reservation date plus a 15-day activation hold term).

request_binding.action_semantics: Activation is owed by the state of the records, not by the caller: the deposit and premium holding fee components together reached the required 3,000.00 on 2026-10-13 while the reservation still stands pending_deposit, so the activation write is due regardless of the request; no other write moves a funded reservation out of pending_deposit.

stage_provenance.fact: The required funds were complete on 2026-10-13 (official ledger rows); the activation itself is performed synchronously by this write.
